subTitle: Ask us anything about Noscentia and our weaving tools, and get clear, factual answers.

faqs.question: What does the Starter Kit include?
faqs.answer: The Starter Kit features essential weaving tools such as lightweight shuttles, bobbins, and basic accessories. It’s a curated selection designed to help both beginners and experienced weavers get started with ease.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade from the Starter Kit to the Professional Collection?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! You can upgrade to the Professional Collection at any time to access a wider variety of premium shuttles, additional bobbins, and advanced weaving tools. You’ll also benefit from priority customer support and exclusive content.

faqs.question: Are discounts available for bulk orders?
faqs.answer: Yes, Noscentia offers exclusive discounts on bulk orders. The discount percentage may vary depending on the quantity and types of tools ordered. Contact us to discuss your needs, and we’ll provide a tailored discount plan.

faqs.question: What kind of customer support can I expect?
faqs.answer: All Noscentia customers receive dedicated email support. With the Starter Kit, you’ll get standard support, while upgrading to the Professional Collection gives you priority support with faster response times and more specialized assistance.

faqs.question: How often are your online resources and guides updated?
faqs.answer: We regularly update our weaving tutorials and resources to reflect the latest techniques and to introduce new Noscentia tools. Our guides are designed to be clear, comprehensive, and useful for all skill levels.

faqs.question: Does Noscentia work with weaving studios or textile centers?
faqs.answer: Yes, Noscentia collaborates with studios, schools, and textile centers. We provide tailored solutions to equip multiple weavers, offering durable tools, bulk options, and expert guidance. Contact us for a customized quote.
